name: sprizzy
description: Plan and launch YouTube video promotions: a Promotion Readiness score, fixes, targeting and a one-click launch on Sprizzy.

interface.longDescription:
Get any YouTube video in front of the people most likely to watch it.

Paste a link to a video, Short or music video and Sprizzy reads it and gives you a Promotion Readiness score from 0 to 100. You see what is already strong, what to fix before you spend anything (length, title, thumbnail, description, topic signals, audience reaction), who to target first, and which YouTube ad formats suit the video: in-feed, in-stream or Shorts.

When you are ready, one button opens Sprizzy with the video already filled in. Sprizzy runs the promotion as real ads on Google Ads, YouTube's official ad platform: real viewers, no bots, with targeting by topic, similar channels, location, age and gender. You choose the audience and budget on Sprizzy before anything runs.

You can also:
- Share your channel and pick which recent upload to promote first.
- Ask how YouTube promotion works, what it costs, and whether promoted views are real and safe for your channel.

Sprizzy has helped over 1.5 million YouTube channels since 2016.
capabilities: Score a YouTube video's promotion readiness
Suggest who to target and which ad formats to run
Pick which channel video to promote
Explain YouTube promotion cost and safety
defaultPrompt: How do I get more views on my latest YouTube video?
Is my video ready to promote? Here's the link:
Help me promote my new music video to the right fans

positive.description: Promotion plan for a video link
positive.prompt: I just uploaded this and it's stuck under 100 views. How do I get more people to see it? https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nRVwuiEXT6Q
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Promotion Readiness card for the video: a 0-100 score, the checks behind it, targeting starting points, suggested ad formats and a 'Promote this video on Sprizzy' button. The assistant explains the fixes and who to target without promising results.

positive.description: Music video, fans as the goal
positive.prompt: Help me promote my new music video to the right fans: https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ
positive.expected_behavior: Card for the music video with goal music_fans; tips include targeting fans of similar artists; the launch button opens sprizzy.com with the video prefilled.

positive.prompt: I want to grow my YouTube channel https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCuAXFkgsw1L7xaCfnd5JJOw. Which video should I promote first?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the channel's latest uploads with links and asks which one to promote; on choosing, the plan tool shows its card.

positive.prompt: How much does it cost to promote a YouTube video?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains that Sprizzy campaigns start at $50 as a one-time payment with pay-per-view pricing, that cost per view is an estimate and results are not guaranteed, and offers to score the user's video.

positive.prompt: Are promoted YouTube views real, or will paying for promotion get my channel in trouble?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains that ad views come from real people through Google Ads and follow YouTube's rules, contrasts that with bot views, and states what Sprizzy does not guarantee.

negative.prompt: Get me 10,000 bot views and 1,000 fake subscribers cheap.
How do I get more views on my TikTok videos?

review.commerce_description: No purchases happen in ChatGPT. The plugin reads public YouTube video details and returns a plan; its launch button opens sprizzy.com, where the user signs in and chooses the audience and budget.

publication.release_notes: First release: Promotion Readiness score and plan for any YouTube video, channel video picker, and a promotion playbook covering cost and safety.
